system.description: You rip open a large portal to the Cosmos, calling down astral debris from the gaping void. Choose one option: you deal 60 damage to one enemy you can see; or you deal 40 damage to every enemy you can see. These amounts increase by 5 if you are level 20 or higher, or by 10 if you are level 40 or higher. Damage dealt by this spell has no type (thus being unaffected by damage Affinities).
